Package com.zen.lib.terminal.commands

Class CommandUtils

java.lang.Object
com.zen.lib.terminal.commands.CommandUtils
public class CommandUtils extends Object
Utility methods for working with command-line style arguments.

This class provides helpers for locating and consuming specific arguments, parsing a raw input line into tokens and validating argument lists against size and allowed values.

  • Method Details

    • findArgument

      public static String findArgument(List<String> arguments, String key)
      Finds the value of a specific argument key and removes it from the list.

      This method assumes that the argument key requires a value and that both the key and its value should be removed from the provided list if found.

      Parameters:
      arguments - the mutable list of arguments to search and modify
      key - the argument key to look for (for example "--name")
      Returns:
      the value associated with the key, or null if the key is not present

    • findArgument

      public static String findArgument(List<String> arguments, String key, boolean isValueRequired)
      Finds the value of a specific argument key and optionally removes it from the list.

      If isValueRequired is true, the method expects the key to be followed by a value and returns that value when present. If no value is found, null is returned.

      Parameters:
      arguments - the mutable list of arguments to search and modify
      key - the argument key to look for
      isValueRequired - true if the key must be followed by a value, false if the presence of the key alone is sufficient
      Returns:
      the value associated with the key, an empty string if the key is present and isValueRequired is false, or null if the key is not found or no value is available

    • findArgument

      public static String findArgument(List<String> arguments, String key, boolean isValueRequired, boolean removeKey)
      Finds the value of a specific argument key with full control over behavior.

      The method scans the argument list for the first occurrence of key. When found, it may treat the next element as the value (if required) and can optionally remove the key and its value from the list.

      Parameters:
      arguments - the mutable list of arguments to search and modify
      key - the argument key to look for
      isValueRequired - true if the key must be followed by a value, false to treat the key as a flag without value
      removeKey - true to remove the key (and its value when required) from the list, false to leave the list unchanged
      Returns:
      the value associated with the key, an empty string if the key is present and isValueRequired is false, or null if the key is not found or if a required value is missing

    • parseArgs

      public static List<String> parseArgs(String input)
      Parses a raw input line into a list of arguments.

      The parser splits the input by whitespace, supports double-quoted segments as single arguments and allows escaping characters using a backslash. Quotes themselves are not included in the resulting tokens.

      Parameters:
      input - the raw input string, for example a command line
      Returns:
      a list of parsed argument tokens; never null

    • isArgumentsValid

      public static boolean isArgumentsValid(List<String> arguments, List<String> validArgs, String argumentStart)
      Validates that all option-like arguments belong to a set of allowed values.

      The method checks each argument that starts with argumentStart (for example a dash or double dash prefix) and verifies it is contained in the validArgs list.

      Parameters:
      arguments - the list of arguments to validate
      validArgs - the collection of allowed arguments
      argumentStart - the prefix that identifies option-style arguments
      Returns:
      true if all matching arguments are valid, false if any unsupported argument is found
